programs.name: CEHG (Center for Computational, Evolutionary and Human Genomics) Fellowships
programs.requirements: Application instructions are in a 2026 PDF linked from the page. Applications are emailed to stanfordcehg@stanford.edu during open periods. The page doesn't list other materials.
programs.eligibility: Graduate students entering the final year of their PhD and early postdoctoral fellows. The page doesn't say whether Stanford affiliation is required or whether international applicants are eligible. Confirm with the center.
programs.deadline_text: The 2026-27 cycle is closed. The page doesn't give the next open period.

programs.name: Stanford Postdoctoral Affairs: Open Postdoctoral Positions board (lab-specific openings, including genomics and ML-for-biology PIs)
programs.requirements: Each posting has its own instructions, usually a CV and cover letter sent to the PI. These are postdoc roles, so the student would need a completed PhD.
programs.eligibility: External PhD holders. The student isn't eligible yet, but the board is useful for identifying labs and planning a future postdoc. The student would likely need a US visa.
programs.deadline_text: Varies by posting

programs.name: Stanford Center for Biomedical Ethics: Postdoctoral Fellowship (genetics/genomics ELSI)
programs.requirements: See the posting. The role covers ethical, legal and social issues in genetics and genomics, so it is only loosely related to the student's interests. The contact is the Fellowship Coordinator named in the posting.
programs.eligibility: Postdoctoral candidates. The student isn't eligible yet. International eligibility isn't stated in the result.
programs.deadline_text: Rolling review. The preferred start was 1 July 2026, but a start as late as fall 2026 was accepted, so the posting may b

programs.name: Stanford Genetics and Genomics Certificate (SCPD online)
programs.requirements: Two required and four elective courses for the certificate of achievement, per a course syllabus. Current admission terms weren't verified.
programs.eligibility: Open to professional and external learners according to older sources. Current terms weren't verified.
programs.deadline_text: Not verified. Check the page.

programs.name: HMS Division of Medical Sciences (GSAS) Visiting Fellows
programs.requirements: An HMS faculty advisor to host the lab research, plus a secondary faculty advisor. Funding at HMS-graduate-student level, from the host lab, your home institution or an individual fellowship. A completed online application and an Assurance of Academic and Financial Support. Full-time enrollment on an F-1 visa. Reduced tuition and health fees are paid each semester.
programs.eligibility: Students in research doctoral programs at universities outside the U.S. who plan to do research in HMS labs. A Canadian PhD student is eligible. The student must secure an HMS host lab in a relevant area, such as DBMI, Genetics, or Systems Biology.
programs.duration: Semester-based. The page gives no maximum, so confirm with special@fas.harvard.edu.
programs.deadline_text: Fall (Sept 1 arrival): March 1. Spring (Feb 1 arrival): October 1, which has passed for Spring 2027. Deadlines are stric

programs.name: Harvard Chan Bioinformatics Core – free training workshops (scRNA-seq, pseudobulk, differential expression, R)
programs.requirements: Registration for each module. Registration pages reportedly open about 3 months before each session, and some are still TBD. I did not open the schedule page itself.
programs.eligibility: Open to the greater Harvard community. Whether outside PhD students can attend was not confirmed, so check with the Core.
programs.duration: Single sessions, with 2027 modules reported for Feb, Mar, May and June
programs.deadline_text: Per-session registration. Dates were not confirmed.

programs.name: Harvard Chan Program in Quantitative Genomics – short courses/workshops (applied AI/ML tools)
programs.requirements: Register through the link on the page. A laptop is needed. Cost was not listed.
programs.eligibility: No formal requirements listed. The course is aimed at clinicians, health researchers and data analysts. The only workshop listed on the page (March 18–20, 2026) is in the past, so check for the next one.
programs.location: Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, Boston, MA
programs.deadline_text: No current workshop listed

programs.name: HMX / Harvard online courses in genetics, omics and AI (HMS and Harvard online learning)
programs.requirements: Online registration. Fees likely apply but were not verified.
programs.eligibility: Open to the public. A 2027-04 session of the HMX Genetics course is listed. I did not open the pages, so check dates and cost.
programs.deadline_text: See the course page

programs.name: MIT Visiting Student (non-degree research visit, faculty-invited)
programs.requirements: Invitation from an MIT faculty member or lab. No central application. Visiting students cannot take classes. Student must be enrolled in a degree program elsewhere.
programs.eligibility: Graduate or undergraduate students at other institutions, including international students (typically J-1 visa via the MIT International Students Office). Departments such as CSAIL and RLE have their own visiting-student procedures.
programs.deadline_text: No fixed deadline. Depends on host faculty and department.

programs.name: Eric and Wendy Schmidt Center Postdoctoral Fellowship (Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard)
programs.requirements: PhD (or in progress) in machine learning, statistics, applied mathematics, computer science or a related field. CV, cover letter, research statement, recommenders. Fellows pick a mentor from Broad, MIT or Harvard-affiliated faculty.
programs.eligibility: Postdoctoral applicants. The page does not state international eligibility. A Canadian PhD student would apply near the end of the PhD and would need a US visa.
programs.deadline_text: Review starts on a rolling basis after 2026-12-22. Appointments start on or after 2027-07-01.

programs.name: Visiting Student Research Collaborator (VSRC) program, Princeton Graduate School
programs.requirements: A named Princeton faculty sponsor, for example a Lewis-Sigler, Computer Science or Molecular Biology PI working in computational biology or genomics. Contact the department's Graduate Program Administrator first. Apply directly to the Graduate School. The appointment is full-time research, and VSRCs cannot take courses for credit or receive a transcript. Visitors or sponsors pay reduced, prorated tuition and fees. Exact application documents were not verified.
programs.eligibility: Advanced degree candidates enrolled in a graduate program at another institution, so a UBC PhD student qualifies. Visa sponsorship is likely needed for a Canadian student. This is unverified.
programs.deadline_text: Not verified. Check the Graduate School VSRC page and confirm with the sponsoring department.

programs.name: Visiting Student Researcher (VSR), Caltech Graduate Studies Office
programs.requirements: Bachelor's degree and current graduate student elsewhere; invitation and sponsorship from a Caltech faculty member; Visiting Student Request form and supporting documents submitted to the Graduate Studies Office at least one month before the visit; official invitation letter issued by the Dean once the package is complete.
programs.eligibility: Non-Caltech graduate students, including international students (typically F-1 I-20 for visa purposes). No academic credit. Not renewable.
programs.deadline_text: Rolling; apply at least one month before the proposed visit

programs.name: CRUK Cambridge Institute – Visiting Students
programs.requirements: Choose a matching research group. Email CV, a letter from your home institution confirming the placement is a valid part of your studies, and a covering letter with proposed dates, project or scope, and any home-university placement scheme. Applicants must secure their own funding, including visa costs.
programs.eligibility: Registered students at another institution who meet Cambridge eligibility criteria. English-language requirement applies if not from a majority English-speaking country. International students are not excluded. The page does not say whether it accepts PhD students specifically.
programs.deadline_text: No deadline listed; contact mailbox-acdev@cruk.cam.ac.uk for timing

programs.name: EMBL-EBI: Proteomics Bioinformatics 2027
programs.requirements: Online application with all documents by 23:59 UK time on 14 March 2027. Fee £975 for academia and £1,275 for industry. Basic mass spectrometry knowledge is an advantage. The page does not mention scholarships.
programs.eligibility: Research scientists with at least a degree in a scientific discipline. No international restriction is stated. This course is proteomics, so it is tangential to the student's genomics focus.
programs.deadline_text: Applications open 14 Dec 2026; close 14 Mar 2027; outcomes by 26 Mar 2027

programs.name: EMBL-EBI: Data Science for Life Scientists
programs.requirements: Online form and a supervisor's letter of support. The 2025 edition charged £900 for academia and offered limited fee waivers and travel grants of up to £500. Python pre-learning is expected.
programs.eligibility: Early-stage data science users, especially PhD students ready to analyse their own data. Only the 2025 edition (16–20 June 2025) was shown on the page, and it is marked ended. A later edition was not confirmed, so check for a new date.
programs.deadline_text: The 2025 deadline was 2 March 2025. No current edition was seen.

programs.name: EMBL-EBI: Genome bioinformatics – from short- to long-read sequencing
programs.requirements: Application via the EMBL-EBI training site. Details were not verified on the official page.
programs.eligibility: Not verified. This course is highly relevant to the student's interests. Dates are uncertain: one listing says 16–20 Nov 2026 and a 2027 poster says 15–19 Nov 2027.
programs.deadline_text: Not verified. Check the EBI training page.

programs.name: Wellcome Connecting Science: Scalable Genomics and Pangenomics
programs.requirements: Application via Wellcome Connecting Science. The 2026 edition is closed.
programs.eligibility: Not verified. Watch for a future edition.
programs.deadline_text: Closed 22 June 2026 for the Oct 2026 edition

programs.name: Early Cancer Institute Summer Programme 2026
programs.requirements: This was an 8-week programme (6 July – 28 August 2026) with 5 places, a stipend and college accommodation. A 2027 round is unconfirmed.
programs.eligibility: Aimed at Master's students, so a PhD student probably does not qualify. The 2026 edition has finished.
programs.deadline_text: 2026 round has passed; no 2027 round confirmed

programs.name: UCL Visiting Research Student (independent application)
programs.requirements: Online application choosing 'Visiting Research' as the programme type. A UCL staff member in the relevant field must be willing to supervise. Applicants need confirmation from their home institution that they are a registered research-degree student and that the visit is supported. Some departments, such as Biosciences, need departmental approval at least 2 months before the start date. Visiting students may have to pay a pro-rata fee, and the fee figures I saw were out of date. UCL does not help with visas, and applicants must show they can fund their own living costs.
programs.eligibility: PhD students registered at another university, including international students. The scheme supports research for a doctorate at the home institution. It does not lead to a UCL degree. A Canadian student would probably need a UK visa for a longer stay.
programs.location: London, UK (host department chosen by the applicant, e.g. Cancer Institute, Genetics Institute or Biosciences)
programs.duration: 3 to 12 months (some departments host shorter stays)
programs.deadline_text: No fixed deadline found. Apply well ahead of the start date (Biosciences needs at least 2 months). Check the host depart

programs.name: UCL Biosciences: visiting postgraduate research students (departmental process)
programs.requirements: A UCL Biosciences PI must agree to host and supervise. The PI then requests departmental approval at least 2 months before the proposed start. This is the route for computational biology and genomics hosts in Biosciences.
programs.eligibility: Registered PhD students from other institutions who have secured a PI host. I did not check the international eligibility details.
programs.deadline_text: Request must go in at least 2 months before the start date.

programs.name: UCL Summer School (e.g. Machine Learning, AI Concepts, Cancer Science and Impact modules)
programs.requirements: Paid, credit-bearing 3-week modules taught on campus. The 2026 machine learning module cost £2,995 per session. Applications for 2026 closed at the end of May.
programs.eligibility: Aimed mainly at undergraduates. I did not confirm that PhD students can enrol, and it is not a funded programme. It is probably a poor fit for a PhD student and is listed only for completeness.
programs.deadline_text: 2027 dates not yet found. The 2026 round closed at the end of May.

programs.name: Postdoctoral fellowships hosted at UCL (MSCA Postdoctoral Fellowships, 2027 entry, shown on UCL STS page)
programs.requirements: Applicants need a UCL host department and must pass its internal selection before submitting. The page I saw is for the Department of Science and Technology Studies, not biology. Check the Faculty of Life Sciences, Population Health Sciences and Cancer Institute research offices for equivalent calls.
programs.eligibility: Postdoctoral applicants. This is only relevant to the student after they finish their PhD. The student is unlikely to meet the eligibility criteria now.
programs.deadline_text: Not a biology call. Dates must be confirmed with the host department.

programs.name: UCL Demand-managed external funding calls (research office list, incl. fellowship schemes needing UCL sponsorship)
programs.requirements: UCL limits how many applications go to some external schemes. Applicants usually need to register interest with UCL and a host department.
programs.eligibility: Early-career researchers, mostly postdoctoral. External applicants are accepted for some schemes. Not applicable to a first-year PhD student now.
programs.deadline_text: Scheme-specific

programs.name: Recognised Student status (visiting research student, graduate research)
programs.requirements: Agreement in principle from an Oxford department and supervisor, then an online application through Graduate Admissions. Fees and other requirements not verified.
programs.eligibility: Graduate research students registered at another university and admitted to do research at Oxford. International students appear eligible, and a visa may be needed. Not verified on the official page.
programs.location: Oxford, UK (host department, e.g. Oncology, Wellcome Centre for Human Genetics, Big Data Institute)
programs.deadline_text: No fixed deadline found; contact the department and supervisor first

programs.name: Oxford visiting researchers: doctoral researchers visiting Oxford
programs.requirements: Host arrangement with an Oxford academic. Details not verified.
programs.eligibility: Doctoral researchers registered at another institution (the page lists them as one of two visiting researcher types). International eligibility not verified.
programs.duration: Not stated in the results I saw
programs.deadline_text: No deadline found

programs.name: Oxford Biomedical Data Science Training Programme (OBDS)
programs.requirements: Application form. Applications were only considered from people working on human samples, and cancer-focused projects got priority for some funded places. This comes from older forms.
programs.eligibility: External applicants are not confirmed. A May 2021 form listed a £6,000 fee, with scholarships from the Precision Medicine Cluster of the Oxford Biomedical Research Centre and the Cancer Research UK Oxford Centre. Current terms not verified.
programs.location: Oxford, UK (MRC WIMM Centre for Computational Biology)
programs.duration: Multi-week course, running once per term in earlier years
programs.deadline_text: The 2023–24 forms are closed; no current round found

programs.name: Oxford Statistical Genomics Summer School
programs.requirements: Application via Oxford Continuing Education. Details for the current year not found.
programs.eligibility: Open to researchers from academia and industry in past editions. Funding not verified.
programs.duration: About one week in June, in past editions
programs.deadline_text: Only the 2023 edition was found (deadline 9 May 2023). No 2026 or 2027 call found.

programs.name: Arc Virtual Cell Challenge 2026
programs.requirements: Register at virtualcellchallenge.org and submit zero-shot perturbation-response predictions; ML or computational biology skills.
programs.eligibility: Individuals, academic labs, companies and independent research organizations are all eligible. Prizes are $100k, $50k and $25k, paid as a mix of cash and NVIDIA Brev credits.
programs.deadline_text: Final submissions due Nov 5, 2026, 11:59 pm UTC; winners announced mid-to-late November

programs.name: Arc Science Fellows Program
programs.requirements: Completed or expected PhD, MD or MD/PhD between spring 2024 and summer 2026; application through the Interfolio portal.
programs.eligibility: Early-career independent group leaders. Not suited to current PhD students. The page does not state international eligibility.
programs.deadline_text: No fixed deadline; reviewed until the position is filled. The eligibility window (PhD by summer 2026) has likely passed.

programs.name: Eric and Wendy Schmidt Center (EWSC) Postdoctoral Fellowship, 2027 cohort
programs.requirements: Cover letter, CV, research statement, three reference letters; experience in machine learning or a related field is critical; biology or medicine experience is helpful but optional; applicant chooses a mentor from Broad-, MIT- or Harvard-affiliated faculty. Applications go through the AJO portal (broad.io/ewsc-postdoc).
programs.eligibility: Postdoctoral applicants with interests in machine learning, statistics or applied mathematics for biomedical research. The official page does not state international eligibility; visa sponsorship was reported in a search result but is not confirmed on the page. Not for current PhD students until they have completed the PhD. Contact ericandwendyschmidtcenter@broadinstitute.org.
programs.deadline_text: Open for 2027; review on a rolling basis after 2026-12-22; start on or after 2027-07-01 (flexible)

programs.name: Scripps Research Fellows Program (independent postdoctoral fellowship)
programs.requirements: Application via Interfolio. Recent PhD, MD, DVM or equivalent, or under 1 year of postdoc, in the biomedical sciences. Projects that use tools to advance basic research are eligible. Applied engineering projects are not.
programs.eligibility: Open to new or soon-to-graduate PhDs. International scholars are eligible, and Scripps Research helps with US legal status. This is a later-stage option, since the student is in their first year of a PhD.
programs.duration: 3 years (from third-party postings; not confirmed on the official page)
programs.deadline_text: First review round covers applications submitted by Dec 31, 2026. Applications are accepted until the position is filled

programs.name: Visiting student (thesis/dissertation research internship, arranged with a host PI)
programs.requirements: Contact a PI whose work fits your interests, with your CV and details of your financial support. If the PI agrees to host you, the PI contacts the International Services Office to start visa sponsorship.
programs.eligibility: Described as for international students enrolled in a degree program outside the US, and you stay enrolled at your home institution. A student from Canada would qualify. J-1 Short-term Scholar or Research Scholar suits students who are mainly funded by their home university. The J Intern category (third-party sponsor, substantial fees) applies to students who rely mainly on personal funds. The International Services Office does not place visiting students.
programs.deadline_text: No fixed deadline. Arranged directly with a host PI.

programs.name: Scripps Research Translational Institute (SRTI) Student Research Internship Program
programs.requirements: Separate application from SURF, via an external link on the page. Details not verified.
programs.eligibility: Page says high school, undergraduate and 'professional students'. It does not mention graduate students, so whether a PhD student from another university can apply is unclear. Interns work in genomics, computational biology and mHealth. Confirm with SRTI.
programs.deadline_text: No deadline listed on the official page

programs.name: Genomic AI Fellows (NYGC)
programs.requirements: PhD in computer science, computational biology, genomics or a related quantitative field. Deep expertise in deep learning and foundation models. Interest in gene regulation, epigenomics or complex disease genetics. Record of leading original research. Apply through the external job posting linked from the page.
programs.eligibility: PhD holders only, so not open to current PhD students. The page does not state international eligibility.
programs.location: New York Genome Center, New York, NY (location not stated on the page)
programs.deadline_text: Not stated on the page; check the linked job posting

programs.name: NYGC Postdoctoral Training Program
programs.requirements: PhD or completion of PhD requirements. Candidates apply through the Open Positions page or contact an NYGC faculty member directly. Interviews include the mentor, lab members and HR, plus a seminar and references.
programs.eligibility: Open to PhD holders, including international candidates, typically sponsored on a J-1 visa. NYGC's Office of International Services supports the visa process, and some visa costs may be reimbursed. Not open to current PhD students.
programs.location: New York Genome Center, New York, NY
programs.deadline_text: No fixed deadline listed; positions are posted by lab

programs.name: Biohub PhD Summer Internship Program (Redwood Shores / Redwood City) – next cycle (2027) not yet announced
programs.requirements: Enrolment in a PhD program. The 2026 cycle was a 10-week, on-site program with computational, imaging, wet-lab and engineering projects, including a Computational Biologist Intern role. Interns arrange their own housing.
programs.eligibility: The 2026 cycle was for full-time graduate students, with an expectation of being enrolled in both Spring and Fall terms. Other universities were not excluded. I could not confirm whether international students can apply or whether Biohub sponsors work authorization. A Canadian student would likely need a US visa.
programs.location: Redwood City / Redwood Shores, CA, USA
programs.deadline_text: The 2026 cycle opened 16 Jan 2026 and had a 1 Feb 2026 deadline, with rolling offers. No 2027 dates were found. Postings

programs.name: Biohub AI Research Intern (PhD), AI Research, Science
programs.requirements: Active enrolment in a PhD program in machine learning/AI, computational biology, physics, applied math or a related quantitative field. The work is research on AI systems for biology.
programs.eligibility: Current PhD students. A listing says Biohub cannot sponsor current or future work authorization for this role, which is a significant barrier for a Canadian student. I did not confirm the current listing's status on an official page.
programs.location: Redwood City, CA or New York, NY (hybrid)
programs.deadline_text: Not verified. This is probably the 2026 cycle posting and is likely closed. Check for a 2027 repost.

programs.name: SSF–CZ Global Science Scholars (postdoctoral fellowship, Biohub + Stellar Science Foundation, US–Japan)
programs.requirements: Doctorate conferred between 1 Jul 2021 and 1 Jul 2025 (PhD in progress was allowed). English proficiency. Visa eligibility. A degree from a Japanese institution for the US track, or from a US institution for the Japan track.
programs.eligibility: The last call needed a degree from a Japanese or US institution, so a Canadian PhD student would probably not qualify. It is not for current PhD students in their first year. No next cycle has been announced.
programs.duration: Up to 2 years (funding runs to Mar 2027)
programs.deadline_text: The RFA closed 27 May 2025. The page announces no future call. Contact: sciencegrants@chanzuckerberg.com

programs.name: Organoids and Beyond: From Development to Disease (conference, with virtual option)
programs.requirements: Online registration; fee applies. Bursaries are generally advertised for students at Sanger conferences. I could not open the event page to confirm details.
programs.eligibility: Open to researchers internationally per the events programme; I could not verify student-specific rules.
programs.location: Wellcome Genome Campus, Hinxton, UK (or virtual)
programs.deadline_text: In-person standard registration 11 Jan 2027; late in-person 1 Feb 2027 (from search snippet; virtual deadline listed amb

programs.name: Sanger Courses and Conferences programme (future 2027 courses, conferences, bursaries)
programs.requirements: Varies by event. Courses usually need an application and a sponsor/supervisor supporting statement.
programs.eligibility: Early- and mid-career scientists internationally. Courses are subsidised and bursaries are available for many events. Late applications are not accepted.
programs.location: Wellcome Genome Campus, Hinxton, UK; also regional hubs in Africa, Asia and Latin America
programs.deadline_text: Deadlines are set per event, typically several months ahead. I found no 2027 genomics, bioinformatics or cancer course l

programs.name: Scalable Genomics and Pangenomics (course)
programs.requirements: Application with a sponsor supporting statement
programs.eligibility: Computational genomics researchers; international applicants accepted
programs.deadline_text: Closed. Application deadline was 22 June 2026. Watch for a repeat in 2027.

programs.name: EMBL-EBI-Sanger Postdoctoral (ESPOD) Fellowship Programme
programs.requirements: PhD-qualified (or about to complete). Pre-defined or self-proposed projects, which need supervisors at both EMBL-EBI and Sanger.
programs.eligibility: Postdoctoral applicants, international applicants accepted. Not for current PhD students until they finish their PhD.
programs.deadline_text: 2026 call closed 27 Sep 2026 (interviews provisionally 10 Dec 2026). Watch for the 2027 call, usually mid-year.

programs.name: Sanger core postdoctoral fellow positions (rolling; Workday)
programs.requirements: PhD, or completing a PhD within 6 months of starting; role-specific skills
programs.eligibility: International applicants may apply. A UK visa would be needed. Not available until near PhD completion.
programs.deadline_text: Recruiting throughout the year; deadlines are per advert

programs.name: Sanger International Fellows Programme (early-career researchers)
programs.requirements: Application by email to the programme. Details are on the Sanger site.
programs.eligibility: Early-career researchers, international. Not for PhD students.
programs.deadline_text: 2026 deadline was 13 Feb 2026 (from search result, not confirmed on the official page)

programs.name: Crick-PACE Postdoctoral Fellowship (collaborative, with KCL/UCL/Imperial)
programs.requirements: PhD held by the call deadline, or thesis defended and awaiting award; not open to people who did their PhD at the Crick; 6-year cap on total Crick postdoc employment
programs.eligibility: International applicants eligible; visa costs reportedly covered. Not usable until you hold a PhD (future option). Details come from job-board listings, not an official Crick page.
programs.location: London, UK (Crick plus a partner university)
programs.deadline_text: Job boards say 6 Jan 2027; a Nature Careers listing says 30 Nov 2026. Confirm on the official PACE page.

programs.name: Crick Summer Student Training Programme
programs.requirements: Second-year undergraduate at a UK university on the Crick priority list
programs.eligibility: Undergraduates at UK universities only, so a PhD student based in Canada is not eligible. The 2026 round closed on 4 Feb 2026; the 2027 round has not been announced.
programs.deadline_text: 2026 deadline was 4 Feb 2026; 2027 dates not yet announced

programs.name: Crick PhD Programme (full 4-year PhD, for reference)
programs.requirements: Application for a full Crick PhD studentship, registered at a partner university (Imperial, KCL or UCL)
programs.eligibility: A full PhD, not a visiting scheme. Not relevant to you as a current PhD student unless you plan to change programmes.
programs.deadline_text: Not verified

programs.name: EMBL Scientific Visitor Programme – external PhD student visits (visiting predoctoral fellow)
programs.requirements: A host agreement with an EMBL group leader (contact one directly). An eligibility questionnaire is offered on the page. A stipend or salary normally continues from the home institute.
programs.eligibility: External PhD students registered at another institution and not in the EMBL International PhD Programme. The search summary said visits over 6 months need Dean of Graduate Studies approval and total time at EMBL must be under half the PhD. I did not confirm those two rules on the page I fetched. The page does not mention nationality limits. A UK visa may be needed. EBI service teams are excluded from the Corporate Partnership fellowship funding, per the search summary. External funding options listed include EMBO Scientific Exchange grants and Boehringer Ingelheim Fonds travel grants.
programs.location: EMBL (EMBL-EBI Hinxton, UK, if hosted by an EBI group)
programs.duration: Not specified; arranged with the host
programs.deadline_text: No deadline listed; contact a host group leader

programs.name: EMBL-EBI–Sanger Postdoctoral (ESPOD) Fellowships
programs.requirements: Submit through the EMBL jobs page only. Include a cover letter, CV and two reference letters. Pick up to 3 of 8 predefined projects or propose a self-designed project (up to 1,000 words) approved by group leaders at both EBI and Sanger.
programs.eligibility: Postdoctoral level, so a future option for the student after the PhD. No nationality restriction is stated. The start date must be within 12 months of the award.
programs.deadline_text: The 2026 call is closed (interviews 10 Dec 2026). The next call is not announced. Past calls opened in summer.

programs.name: EMBL-EBI Training: Data science for life scientists (includes ML)
programs.requirements: Beginner-level Python. Application documents are due by the deadline. 30 places, selected by application.
programs.eligibility: Life scientists, especially PhD students and early-career researchers, who want to analyse their own data. International applicants are welcome. A UK visa may be needed. Fee: £975 academic.
programs.deadline_text: Applications open 30 Nov 2026 and close 23:59 UK time on 28 Feb 2027. Outcomes by 15 Mar 2027.

programs.name: EMBL-EBI Training: Single-cell RNA-seq analysis in Python (virtual)
programs.requirements: Basic Unix command line and basic Python. Available 09:00–17:30 UK time each day.
programs.eligibility: Aimed at wet-lab researchers working with scRNA-seq data. The page states no nationality restriction. Fee: £250 academic. Limited financial assistance is available. Note the UK-hours schedule falls in the early morning for Pacific time.
programs.deadline_text: 23:59 UK time, 10 Jan 2027. Outcomes by 22 Jan 2027.

programs.name: EMBL-EBI Training: Genome bioinformatics: from short- to long-read sequencing
programs.requirements: See the course page. I did not fetch the application details.
programs.eligibility: Not verified. The listing only gives the topic as NGS data analysis workflows, tools and resources.
programs.location: EMBL-EBI, Hinxton, UK (per search listing; not verified)
programs.deadline_text: Not verified

programs.name: EMBL-EBI Training: Introduction to RNA-seq and functional interpretation (virtual)
programs.requirements: See the course page. I did not fetch the application details.
programs.eligibility: Not verified.
programs.deadline_text: Not verified

programs.name: EMBL-EBI Training: Introduction to multi-omics data integration and visualisation
programs.requirements: See the course page. Details not verified.
programs.eligibility: Not verified.
programs.deadline_text: Dates not confirmed

programs.name: EMBL-EBI Training: Proteomics bioinformatics
programs.requirements: See the course page. Details not verified.
programs.eligibility: Not verified. It is less relevant to the student's cancer genomics interests.
programs.deadline_text: Applications open 14 Dec 2026; the deadline was not verified

programs.name: Postdoctoral Training Fellow posts, Centre for Evolution and Cancer (individual vacancies; example: Genomics and Evolutionary Dynamics)
programs.requirements: PhD in computational or mathematical biology, ideally applied to cancer, with experience in advanced analysis of cancer genomes. Some postings accept candidates still finishing their PhD, with the PhD confirmed within 6 months of starting.
programs.eligibility: Open competitive job posts. The posting I saw says the role is eligible for ICR visa sponsorship. Not a PhD-student scheme; relevant only near graduation.
programs.deadline_text: Postings I saw had 2025 or early 2026 closing dates and are probably closed. Check jobs.icr.ac.uk for current vacancies.

programs.name: Evolutionary Biology and Ecology of Cancer (Wellcome Connecting Science course, hosted at ICR; 2025 edition)
programs.requirements: Application with a supporting statement

programs.name: LMB Student Placement Scheme (in-house)
programs.requirements: Undergraduate placement; application via LMB Postgraduate Office. Salary paid.
programs.eligibility: Undergraduates who are UK nationals or meet UK residence requirements. Overseas students need to be enrolled full time at a UK university with a valid student visa, or come through the UKRI Temporary Worker Exchange Scheme. The page does not mention PhD students, so a Canadian PhD student is probably not eligible.
programs.deadline_text: 2026 applications closed; no 2027 deadline published

programs.name: LMB Postdoc Fellowship - Rising Talent (Black heritage scientists)
programs.requirements: Postdoctoral applicant; see the additional-information PDF. Fully funded 3-year fellowship, up to 2 per year.
programs.eligibility: Scientists of Black heritage. A PhD is expected, so this is a future option only. Visa and immigration costs may be reclaimable from UKRI, according to LMB postdoc adverts.
programs.deadline_text: 2026 round closed 17 May 2026; 2027 round not yet announced

programs.name: LMB Postdoc Fellowship - Career Returner
programs.requirements: Postdoctoral applicant; see the additional-information PDF. Fully funded 3-year fellowship, aiming for 1 per year.
programs.eligibility: Scientists returning after a career break of at least 12 months. A PhD is expected, so this is a future option only.
programs.deadline_text: 2026 round closed 17 May 2026; 2027 round not yet announced
